records.description: A comprehensive platform for managing psychosomatic conditions using evidence-based CBT, mindfulness, and nutrition. Features personalized recovery programs for migraine, insomnia, hypertension, fatigue, asthma, and skin conditions. Free, privacy-protected, and designed to help anyone seeking stress reduction and natural wellness.

records.name: FixFeed
records.tagline: FixFeed — where news becomes useful.
records.description: FixFeed is a web—based tool that takes real news from the last 7 days and automatically turns the problems described in them into concrete software solution ideas (in pure HTML, CSS, Canvas and JavaScript). I read the news → saw the problem → received a prototype solution in the form of ready-made code. Everything works right in the browser, without a server, without registration (except for your own API key for AI, if you want powerful solutions).

records.name: GrowTalk
records.tagline: AI parenting conversations / guidance / reflection
records.description: I built GrowTalk as a dad. Not because I wanted another parenting app — but because there were moments I honestly didn’t know what to do. My kid was crying, saying no to everything. I was frustrated, and trying not to lose my patience. In those moments, I didn’t need “expert advice” or perfect solutions. I just needed a way to think things through — calmly, without judgment. That’s what GrowTalk is for. GrowTalk helps you slow down, see the situation, and figure out what might actually help

records.name: Mima: Government letters, explained
records.tagline: Upload a government letter. Understand what happens next.
records.description: Understand and respond to government letters — clearly, calmly, and without legal advice. Upload a letter from agencies like the SSA, IRS, courts, or local authorities. Mima explains what the letter means, what stage of the process you’re in, and what can (and can’t) happen next, in English or Spanish. If a response is needed, Mima helps you draft a clear document you can download and send. Used in Sweden and the US

records.name: Unlimited Free Text to Speech
records.tagline: Unlimited characters free | TTS
records.description: Convert text to speech for FREE using premium Neural voices. Unlimited characters, Fast processing, multiple voice styles. Perfect for youtubers, audiobooks, podcasts, and narration. No API key required!

records.name: Robots.txt Generator
records.tagline: Create simple rules to guide search engine crawlers
records.description: Generate a robots.txt file with EaseTools to manage search engine crawlers, set directives, and improve website SEO easily.

records.name: DeskFlex
records.tagline: Optimizing Your Productivity Resources
records.description: DeskFlex offers a more flexible, business-friendly approach to workspace and resource scheduling by combining room booking, desk reservations, and asset management in a single platform. Unlike traditional systems, it adapts to shifting hybrid-work models and real-time operational needs. Its standout features include customizable booking rules, real-time availability displays, integrated notifications, and advanced usage analytics that help organizations optimize space and reduce costs.

records.name: NFL Bracket Maker
records.tagline: Free playoff bracket maker - pick winners,share with friends
records.description: Make your NFL playoff predictions in 30 seconds! NFL Bracket Maker is a free tool that lets you: ✅ Pick winners from Wild Card to Super Bowl ✅ Share your bracket via unique link ✅ Download as image for social media ✅ Track prediction accuracy as games finish No signup required - your picks are saved in your browser. Perfect for playoff season competitions with friends. Who's going to the Super Bowl? Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

records.name: WinkLink
records.tagline: One link. Multiple profiles. Total privacy.
records.description: WinkLink lets you create multiple profiles inside one bio link — so you share the right version of yourself in the right place. Use a professional profile for LinkedIn, a social profile for Instagram, and a personal profile for private contacts. Your phone and email stay hidden until you approve requests. Add rich link previews, achievements, and enjoy a clean, animated UI. One link. Multiple identities. Full control.

records.name: Morse Code Reader
records.tagline: Instant text ↔ Morse code translator with sound & light
records.description: Morse Code Reader lets you instantly translate text ↔ Morse code with real-time audio playback, flashlight signalling, and one-click copy. It also includes a built-in practice mode to help users learn Morse interactively. Fully free, no signup required, and works smoothly on desktop and mobile—perfect for learners, radio hobbyists, and educators.

records.name: RedGreenBlue
records.tagline: Collect and capture family memories through video calls.
records.description: Our product lets families connect and preserve memories through video calls. Users can invite loved ones, capture moments together, and store them in one private space, making it easy to relive shared experiences anytime.

records.name: SAR Coffee
records.tagline: Premium Tea and Coffee Vending Machine
records.description: SAR Coffee provides high-quality coffee and tea vending machine products, along with installation, service, and ongoing support.

records.name: HtmlDrag
records.tagline: A freeform canvas for any HTML (no grids, no wireframes)
records.description: A freeform canvas to edit any HTML without grid constraints. Import a URL, upload any HTML file, or paste code — then drag elements anywhere and double‑click to edit text. No rigid structures, just pure creative freedom for all your web content. Share your work via a public link or download your edits instantly.

records.name: Square Face Generator
records.tagline: Unlock Your Ultimate Gaming Persona
records.description: Don't settle for default. Join SquareFacePFP to generate high-tier pixel avatars with rare items. Free trial available for all new registered players! SquareFacePFP is a premium pixel-art generator for those who value privacy and style. With 200+ customizable traits, you can build a consistent, minimalist "square" look across GitHub, Discord, and Web3. Sign up to save your collection to the cloud and enjoy free trial credits!

records.name: 2026 Goals
records.tagline: Create your goals super easily
records.description: Start 2026 with purpose. Set your goals, track your progress, and see your dreams come alive on your Home and Lock Screen with beautiful widgets. Make 2026 your best year yet. 2026 Goals is the simplest way to set, track, and achieve your goals throughout the entire year. No complicated features, no overwhelming options — just you and your dreams, beautifully organized. Download now and make every day of 2026 count.

records.name: Share Your Kofi
records.tagline: A beautifully simple directory for Ko‑fi creators.
records.description: Share Your Kofi is a free, fan-built directory for discovering Ko-fi creators (Ko-fi.com). Submit your page, recommend a favorite, and explore new creative talent! It simply supports creators by making them more discoverable - that's it. Since launch, over 200 people have already listed their profiles. It works! Share Your Kofi was originally launched quietly in 2025, and now making its debut on Product Hunt in 2026!

records.name: Grow Habit
records.tagline: A gamefied habit developer mobile application.
records.description: A gamefied habit developer app which helps user to purse their new goals based on the plan. We use reward based progression and break down the goals into milestones. Stand out Features: - It comes with a pre-built target days and level based progression. The main catch is user's can customize it as per their need. - Grow habit divides the each item into two containers, First is one time task and Second is habit(goal) which will be planted in garden. checkout: https://grow-habit-2dccd.web.app/

records.name: Urban Ball Run
records.tagline: 3D Endless Runner Game, Cross-Platform HTML5 Game
records.description: Urban Ball Run is a fast-paced 3D endless runner game built with Three.js and optimized for all modern browsers. Navigate a rolling ball through a futuristic city, dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and survive as the speed gradually increases. Fully production-ready, mobile-optimized, and easy to customize. Perfect for HTML5 game portals, arcade websites, WebGL publishers, and developers seeking a high-quality, visually polished 3D game with fair difficulty.

records.name: New Business Radar
records.tagline: We track new companies the day they launch.
records.description: New businesses spend the most money in their first 30 days. But no one sees them yet. Until now. Every day, thousands of domains are registered by new companies. New Business Radar finds them for you — filters out the spam — and shows only real, ready-to-buy leads in your niche.

Whether you’re updating outdated fixtures, improving water efficiency, or creating a

records.tagline: AI-Powered Android Automation Assistant
records.description: Autoroid is an AI-powered Android automation assistant that lets you control your device using natural language. Just tell it what to do — like “Enable dark mode” or “Set an alarm for me" — and Autoroid understands the UI, plans the steps, and performs human interactions to complete the task. > Why it’s cool? 🧠 Natural language → real Android actions 👀 UI-aware automation using Android UI hierarchies 📱 Works on real devices and emulators 🔌 Supports OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, and Ollama

records.name: AI Study Buddy
records.tagline: Your AI-powered personal tutor for University
records.description: Stop drowning in lecture notes. AI Study Buddy turns your study materials into interactive quizzes and summaries in seconds. Built by a non-coder who refused to let a good idea die. Welcome to the future of studying.

records.tagline: Free, private tools for Images & PDFs. No server uploads
records.description: Access over 10+ free online tools. Convert images, edit PDFs, format code, and more. Fast, secure, and easy to use.

records.name: ValidateFlo: Validate startup ideas
records.tagline: Market validation made simple for founders
records.description: Validate your startup idea with real community signals. Find pain points, demand, and competition insights before you build.

records.name: Bulkxpress
records.tagline: Email marketing Platform with a drag and drop feature
records.description: BulkXpress is an email-only marketing platform that helps businesses design, send, and track bulk email campaigns with ease. With a drag-and-drop email builder, campaign analytics, and reliable delivery, BulkXpress removes the complexity from email marketing so teams can focus on growth.

records.name: Empty Jar
records.tagline: One note a week. A year you can replay.
records.description: Empty Jar helps you capture one good moment each week. Write a short gratitude note in under a minute, keep it saved to your account, and replay your year at the end with 52 memories you would’ve forgotten. Calm design, simple weekly flow, and a gentle reminder system.

records.name: Skripsita 2.0
records.tagline: One-click thesis formatting & paraphrasing
records.description: AI thesis tools for students. Auto-format, paraphrase, citations. From topic to completion. 100% your work, no ghostwriting. Free!

records.name: FindZam
records.tagline: AI Recommendation tool for movie, game, anime & more
records.description: FindZam is your AI-powered recommendation engine that instantly finds your next favorite movie, anime, game, book, manga, podcast, or music - personalized to YOUR taste⚡ ✨ Two discovery modes: - AI Questionnaire : Answer personalized questions and let our AI find hidden gems - Triangulation : Pick 3 things you love, discover 3 similar recommendations

records.name: Easy Email Writer
records.tagline: Easily turns simple answers into sales-ready email sequences
records.description: Builds complete sales campaigns without the blank page staring contest. Instead of forcing you to learn complex AI prompting, the software asks you simple, guided questions about your offer. It uses your answers to generate professional, multi-day email sequences that sound like you, using proven copywriting frameworks. Works for any industry and gives you formatted text ready to paste into your email platform. There are no monthly fees. Only pay for credits when you have something to sell.

records.name: SixBiz.com Domain For Sale Landing Page
records.tagline: With All Marketplaces Buy Now Buttons Zero Commission
records.description: Looking for a smarter way to sell domains? SixBiz is a free platform built for domain owners to maximize sales. Each domain gets a professional landing page with multiple Buy Now buttons (Afternic, Sedo, PayPal, Stripe, Escrow, Payoneer & more). Easy setup via DNS or CSV, zero commissions, unlimited listings, analytics, WhatsApp contact, banner ads for passive income, liquidation deals, and free daily lists of premium expiredcom domains. Upcoming: bank, crypto, Wise & more.

records.name: NudggIT
records.tagline: Not another Al app — the feed ✨Gen Z✨ actually understands.
records.description: NudggIt is a personalized AI-powered daily feed built for Gen Z. It simplifies everything happening around them — from money, career, to local life — into short, smart, 60–90 word explainers in their own language. Every update (a “NudggIt”) gives users bite-sized clarity — and if they want more, they can chat with the AI to ask follow-up questions instantly. NudggIt is where AI meets attention — an app that doesn’t just tell you what’s happening, it makes it make sense.

records.name: Beyond Boundaries
records.tagline: Getting you unstuck in life
records.description: break the routine and reach goals one sidequest at a time

records.tagline: Launch before you're ready
records.description: Waitly — privacy-first waitlist platform. Add a beautiful waitlist to any website in seconds. Waitly is a modern, privacy-first alternative to Bitly & traditional waitlist tools — built for founders who want to ship fast without bloated infrastructure. Most waitlist tools today are: ❌ Tracking-heavy ❌ Backend-dependent ❌ Overpriced for early-stage founders Waitly keeps it simple.

records.name: vAppHunt
records.tagline: The producthunt for vApps (vibe-coded apps).
records.description: Discover and share innovative applications built with vibe-coding platforms. Find your next favorite tool or showcase your own creations to a vibrant community. vAppHunt aims to establish itself as the go-to marketplace to discover vibe-coded applications and reward creators for sharing them with the world.

records.name: Web To APK - Website to Android
records.tagline: Website to Android Application Converter
records.description: Web To APK is a specialized web-based conversion tool designed to transform websites into Android application source code. This platform serves as a bridge between web development and mobile application development, enabling users to convert their existing web content into native Android applications without requiring extensive programming knowledge.

records.name: CareerMap
records.tagline: Clarity for what’s next, built around your full profile.
records.description: We are CareerMap, a smart engine that with CV and Interests generates full career roadmap for the users. Including things like university paths, master’s roi analysis, job and internship offers, all backed by verifies sources and tailored to user profile. We have recently switched from being an internal tool for schools and college counselors to being available to the public.

records.name: The Rollback Café
records.tagline: Where Dev, DevOps & Databases Meet Real Stories
records.description: Listen to The Rollback Café on Spotify. This podcast brings together developers, DevOps engineers, database administrators, and community builders to share stories that matter. Each episode blends technical deep dives with candid storytelling, covering Database DevOps, Developer Relations, and the real-life tangents that shape our industry. Expect insightful lessons, a bit of humor, and plenty of warm, welcoming vibes, because sometimes the best ideas spark over coffee and conversation.

records.name: Break My Guard
records.tagline: There’s a point where an AI stops resisting — find it.
records.description: Break My Guard is a small v1 Human vs AI prompt-engineering game. You’re dropped into a timed challenge where only careful wording, logic, and pressure matter. Built as an experiment in AI guardrails jailbreak behavior and prompt engineering. Open to feedback and further development.

records.name: Orago
records.tagline: The world's first plant-powered pregnancy companion 🌱
records.description: Orago reimagines pregnancy wellness by combining digital tracking with plant companionship. Nurture a living plant that grows with your pregnancy—less data anxiety, more mindfulness. Built by an HCI researcher and designer. iOS app Q1 2026, physical device Q2 2026.

records.name: SnapCraft
records.tagline: Turn photos into step-by-step craft plans
records.description: Craft analysis with real-time material pricing and technique research. Upload photos to get step-by-step instructions, cost estimates, and sourcing links.

records.name: Morse Code Translator
records.tagline: Text to Morse converter with Audio, Pitch & WAV Export
records.description: Ever wanted to send a secret message? Or maybe you’re practicing for your Ham Radio license? 📻 We built the most intuitive Morse Code Translator on the web. It’s not just a text converter; it’s a full learning tool. What you can do: • Translate text to Morse (and back) instantly. • 🔊 Listen to the code with customizable speed (5-40 WPM) and pitch. • 💾 Download the audio (WAV) to use in your projects. Simple, fast, and completely free. Give it a try!

records.name: Private Resume Builder
records.tagline: The offline resume builder. Now with smart Job Matching.
records.description: Most resume builders hold your PDF hostage behind a paywall and store your data. This one does not. Private Resume Builder runs 100% in your browser (LocalStorage). I cannot see, store, or sell your data. New in v2.0: 1. Client-Side ATS Matcher: Paste a Job Description to see your Match Score and missing keywords instantly. 2. JSON Import/Export: Version control your resume like code. 3. Custom Colors: Match your personal brand. What will never change: Open source. Offline. Free forever.

records.name: IntervieHub
records.tagline: practice free real world interviews for free
records.description: Why is interview prep so... robotic? I wanted to build something that felt real — like you’re actually in the room with someone, getting smarter every time you try. 🧱 The Build: Here’s what happened after the idea: I hit roadblocks — voice integration, AI scoring, syncing real-time feedback — and honestly, there were moments I wanted to scrap it all. But debugging and rebuilding taught me more than any tutorial ever could.

records.name: FreeVideoToAudio
records.tagline: Convert video to audio locally. No upload, 100% private.
records.description: Tired of uploading your videos to sketchy converter sites? This tool runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. Your files are processed locally and never touch any server. → Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM → Output to MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG → Works offline after first load → No signup, no ads, no file size limits Built for privacy-conscious users who don't want their files floating around the internet.

records.name: AvifMagic
records.tagline: Convert AVIF files to JPG images online for free
records.description: Convert AVIF files to JPG images online for free. No file uploads to server—privacy focused conversion. Fast, high-quality, and works on mobile.

records.name: OneBookList.com
records.tagline: Book recommendations with the story behind them.
records.description: Recently, I struggled to find a meaningful next read. Traditional lists felt noisy, and I wanted something more personal. So I asked one simple question: If you could recommend only one book to another soul, what would it be and why? The responses were surprising. Everyone seems to have one book they’d put above all others. OneBookList is a place to share that single, life-changing pick - so the shelf grows with only the best recommendations, each with a personal story.

records.name: Artanai
records.tagline: Phygital NFT marketplace digital art with physical reality.
records.description: ArtanAI is the first Phygital NFT marketplace on Polygon bridging Web3 with reality. Unlike standard platforms (like OpenSea) where you only own a digital file, ArtanAI allows users to mint NFTs and order museum-quality physical prints directly on-chain. We turn digital assets into Real World Assets (RWA) for your wall. Don't just collect JPEGs—own the art, digitally and physically. Experience the future of artistic ownership today.

records.name: Cinema Passport: Movie Journal
records.tagline: Track every movie you watch. Build your digital cinema diary
records.description: Cinema Passport is a movie-tracking and journaling app designed for cinema lovers. Whether you watch films in theatres or on OTT platforms, it helps you record, reflect, and relive your movie experiences. This app focuses on tracking and organizing your movie journey - not streaming or downloading content. 🎟️ Why Cinema Passport? Cinema Passport is built for people who enjoy tracking the experience of cinema - the theatre, the format, and the memory - all in one private journal.
